AESI, Centre Street, Credit Master Fund, Credit Strategies, SKSI Fund, Credit Opportunity, Franklin Fund, Lincoln Fund, SOMA Fund, Zeus LP, SPN Fund and Vulcan LP (collectively, the “Apollo Funds”) each hold shares of Common Stock of the Issuer.  Euro Management serves as the investment manager of AESI, and Euro Management GP serves as the general partner of European Management.  Centre Street Management serves as the investment manager of Centre Street.  ST Management serves as the investment manager of Credit Master Fund and Credit Strategies.  Apollo ST Operating serves as the sole member of ST Management, ST Capital serves as the general partner of ST Operating, and ST Management Holdings serves as the sole member of ST Capital.

 

SK Strategic LP serves as the sole shareholder of SKSI Fund, and SK Strategic Management serves as the investment manager of SK Strategic LP.  Credit Opportunity Management serves as the investment manager for Credit Opportunity.  Franklin Management serves as the investment manager for Franklin Fund, and Lincoln Management serves as the investment manager for Lincoln Fund.

 

SOMA Advisors serves as the general partner of SOMA Fund, and SOMA Capital Management serves as the general partner of SOMA Advisors.  SVF Management serves as the investment manager of SOMA Fund, and SVF Management GP serves as the general partner of SVF Management.  Zeus Advisors LP serves as the general partner of Zeus LP, and Zeus Advisors GP serves as the general partner of Zeus Advisors LP.  APH Holdings (DC) serves as the sole member of each of Zeus Advisors GP and SOMA Capital Management.  Principal IV GP serves as the general partner of APH Holdings (DC).

 

SPN Investments serves as the sole member of SPN Fund, and SPN Management serves as the investment manager of SPN Investments.

 

Advisors VIII and Advisors ANRP serve as the general partners of Vulcan LP.  Capital Management VIII serves as the general partner of Advisors VIII.  APH Holdings serves as the sole member of Capital Management VIII, and Principal III GP serves as the general partner of APH Holdings.  ANRP Capital Management serves as the general partner of Advisors ANRP.  Principal I serves as the sole member and manager of ANRP Capital Management, and Principal I GP serves as the general partner of Principal I.

 

Capital Management serves as the sole member of each of Euro Management GP, Centre Street Management, Credit Opportunity Management, Franklin Management, Lincoln Management, SVF Management GP and SPN Management, and the sole member-manager of each of ST Management Holdings and SK Strategic Management.  Capital Management GP serves as the general partner of Capital Management.  Management Holdings serves as the sole member-manager of Capital Management GP, and Management Holdings GP serves as the general partner of Management Holdings.
